description: 约时间、改时间、AA、临时取消——用轻松但不失礼貌的方式把计划定下来。

targetChunks.note: 约人最直接的问法；后面最好接具体计划。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Are you free on Saturday? A few of us are going hiking.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 周六有空吗？我们几个人去徒步。

targetChunks.note: easy = 随意、不挑，口语；比 I don't care 礼貌。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm easy either way — you pick.

targetChunks.en: How about we play it by ear?
targetChunks.note: play it by ear = 不提前定死，灵活安排。
targetChunks.exampleEn: How about we play it by ear and decide on the day?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 不如到时候看情况，当天再定？

targetChunks.en: I might have to take a rain check.
targetChunks.note: rain check = 改日再约；比 I can't come 轻松。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I might have to take a rain check — something came up.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我可能得改天，临时有事。

targetChunks.note: 不解释细节的常用理由，朋友之间很自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Something came up at work. Can we push it back?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 工作上临时有事。能往后推吗？

targetChunks.note: split the bill = 平摊账单；比 go Dutch 更常用。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Let's split the bill — it's easier that way.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我们 AA 吧，这样简单。

targetChunks.note: get this one = 我来买单；朋友间很自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'll get this one — you paid last time.

targetChunks.en: Can we push it back by half an hour?
targetChunks.note: push back by + 时间，改约高频。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Can we push it back by half an hour?

targetChunks.en: I'm on the fence about going out.
targetChunks.zh: 我还在犹豫要不要出去。
targetChunks.note: on the fence = 犹豫；比 I'm not sure 更形象。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm on the fence about going out tonight.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我还在犹豫今晚要不要出去。

targetChunks.note: overcomplicate = 把简单事弄复杂；约计划时很实用。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Let's not overcomplicate it — dinner at seven works.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 别搞太复杂，七点吃饭就行。

targetChunks.en: Text me when you're on your way.
targetChunks.note: on one's way = 在路上/出发；比 when you leave 自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Text me when you're on your way.

roleplay.promptZh: 朋友约你周六徒步。你最近很忙、还在犹豫，最后决定灵活处理；顺便聊到午饭谁买单。
roleplay.promptEn: A friend invites you hiking on Saturday. You're busy and undecided, so you keep it flexible and sort out lunch.
goals: 用 play it by ear 保持灵活
自然处理 AA / 请客

script.speaker: other
script.en: Are you free on Saturday? A few of us are going hiking.
script.zh: 周六有空吗？我们几个人去徒步。

script.speaker: you
script.en: I might be. I'm on the fence about going out, to be honest — I've been swamped.
script.zh: 可能有空。说实话我还在犹豫要不要出去，最近忙不过来。

script.speaker: other
script.en: No pressure. We can play it by ear.
script.zh: 没压力。我们可以到时候看情况。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Let's do that. If I can make it, I'll text you when I'm on my way.
script.zh: 就这么办。如果能去，我出发时给你发消息。

script.speaker: other
script.en: Perfect. And let's split the bill for lunch.
script.zh: 好。午饭我们 AA 吧。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Sounds good. I'll get this one next time.

script.speaker: other
script.en: Deal. Don't overcomplicate it — just come if you can.
script.zh: 成交。别想太复杂，能来就来。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Appreciate it. I might have to take a rain check, but I'll let you know.
script.zh: 谢谢。我可能会改天，但会告诉你。
